decisive_items: Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma
A subcutaneous nodule of approximately 1 cm diameter was present under the hypogastrium.
A linear scar was observed in the lower-left abdominal region.
response.rationale: Endometrial glands and stroma in a subcutaneous abdominal wall nodule near a prior scar, with menstruation-related pain, is diagnostic of abdominal wall endometrioma.
